name: Should I choose a honed or polished finish for my marble tile?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a honed or polished finish for my marble tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose honed marble if slip resistance and lower-maintenance surface appearance are your priorities, and choose polished marble if you want deep color reflection. Honed marble has a smooth, matte finish that conceals water spots and minor scuffs well, making it practical for high-traffic entryways and bathroom floors. Polished marble creates a glossy, light-reflecting look that highlights natural veining, but it scratches more visibly under grit and gets dangerously slippery when wet. Vertical walls and formal powder rooms work well for polished finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Honed marble provides a matte, slip-resistant finish ideal for floors, while polished marble offers high-gloss drama best suited for walls and dry areas.
